verdict.rationale: Parsec's downloads page lists a "Web Google Chrome" platform option, and its docs say a shared link lets a team member observe or take control. Together these suggest a browser-based client exists. However, the evidence never states that the web client needs nothing installed, works in browsers beyond Chrome, or is the path the shared link opens. Missing for 10: explicit confirmation of zero-install browser access, support for browsers other than Chrome, documentation of view and control from the web client, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power user, someone can view or control a session from a plain browser with nothing installed

citations.quote: share a link, and a team member can observe or even take control of your computer.
